conclusion: The documented managed-mode descriptor hazard is present in the source pattern and reproduced by the separate controlled diagnostic. This supports a source-only, app-scoped managed-heap ownership candidate. The exact full-case faulting instruction and the safety of all downstream library captures remain unproven; no runtime acceptance is given.
direct_source_findings: FOAM_OFFLOAD apply_policy uses par_unseq only when ListPolicy::use_offload(length) is true; that threshold is >=1000, otherwise seq.
The relevant dotInterpolate inner lambda captures by reference and subscripts vfi, lambda, P, N, Sfi and sfi.
Field inherits List, which inherits UList. UList stores size_ and v_; operator[] must obtain v_ through its object before indexing data.
The primary U and p objects are local stack descriptors; phi is a stack object through createPhi.H. The mesh is already heap-owned.
The matrix source_, internalCoeffs_, boundaryCoeffs_ and coeffsOffset_ descriptors are inline members of fvMatrix, even when their element buffers are separately allocated.

recommended_candidate_contract: Use local autoPtr/unique ownership with new plus existing named references, preserving IO names, registry flags, constructors, expressions, scope and destruction order.
Keep all equations, source fragments, controller timing, boundary policies, schemes and numeric criteria unchanged. Keep strict-pressure protocol adaptation separate.
Preserve existing checked synchronization before temporaries and owner destruction.
Require CUDA type3 for each owning object and its embedded primitive Field descriptor, separately from data-pointer type3. Check U immediately before fvc::flux initialization.
Check source/matrix inline Field descriptors and relevant addressing/weight/geometry descriptors when naturally available.
Do not prime oldTime history or materialize extra fields solely for pointer checks; observe oldTime descriptors only at existing natural accesses.
Compile same source for CPU and GPU, recheck exact full-size initialized U/p/phi, then individual five-step field/force/power/continuity/source gates and actual GPU-path coverage.

raw_pointer_patch_alternative.assessment: A narrow operation-specific pointer-by-value kernel removes descriptor dereferences, preserving face addressing, arithmetic order and boundaries.
cautions: Extract cdata()/data() on host and explicitly capture raw pointer values; retaining reference capture of local pointer variables is not a general portable cure.
Do not blindly replace [&] with [=] on owning Field objects; that may introduce deep copies, different lifetimes or unsupported copies.

Generic dotInterpolate also serves geometricOneField; its stateless Internal sentinel does not offer a universal cdata() API, so a generic patch needs an explicit specialization/trait rather than assuming all SFType values are stored arrays.

sanitizer.reported_attempt: Actual child-6 and tool86 with CUDA initialized before the Sanitizer; no usable kernel/address attribution
sanitizer.documented_diagnostic: NVIDIA recommends a GDB cuInit stack trace and, if CUDA is entered from a global initializer, deferring that call until after sanitizer injection libraries preload.
sanitizer.option_cautions: require-cuda-init=no controls a target that does not use CUDA; injection-path selects tool libraries. Neither is documented as a universal fix for early initialization.
